test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Mudassir warned the child, “Be careful and be slow.”

options.text: Mudassir warned the child that he be careful and be slow.
Mudassir warned the child to be careful and to be slow.
Mudassir warned the child to be careful and should be slow.
Mudassir warned the child that he should be careful and be slow.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Mudassir warned the child to be careful and to be slow."**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** **

 
• The rules of Direct and Indirect speech for imperative sentences conversions.
 
 
• The reporting verb said/said to is changed to asked, demanded, requested, ordered, enquired, and offered as per the nature of the sentence.
 
• Imperative sentences do not normally have an expressed subject.
 
• This is because the subject ‘you’ is usually understood.
 
• When the reporting verb is in the past (said) and the direct speech is in the present indefinite tense (simple present tense), then the indirect (reported) speech will change into the past indefinite tense.
 
• In order to change an imperative sentence into indirect speech, we use a to-infinitive.
 
 
• Example: 
 
• *The old woman said to the boy, ‘Please help me till he returns.’*
 
• *The old woman requested the boy to help her till he returned.*
 
 
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence: *Mudassir warned the child to be careful and to be slow.*
